faq.q: Why use titanium for titanium surgical scissors pivot pin?
faq.a: Grade 2 (CP-Ti) is widely used for surgical instruments due to its excellent corrosion resistance in autoclave environments and adequate strength. Grade 5 for high-stress instruments.

faq.q: How is a titanium surgical scissors pivot pin manufactured?
faq.a: A typical titanium surgical scissors pivot pin is manufactured using VAR melting; Closed-die hot forging; CNC swiss turning; Thread rolling. Each step is critical to achieving the required mechanical properties and dimensional tolerances.

faq.a: Stainless steel (heavier, less fatigue life), aluminum (lower strength)

faq.q: What standards apply to titanium surgical scissors pivot pin?
